lede: Wat Don Pin accounts for 14 catalogued manuscripts. It clusters in Chiang Mai (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (79%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (21%). Dated witnesses run 1900–1939 CE (9 of 14 carry a date).
